rows.coder_note: Step 4 (rules D, I1): the abstract names the FinnGen study with endpoint case and control counts only (equal to no row's N); no release number, accession or citation. The outcome side has FinnGen rows, so rule C2 does not make it absent.

Step 4 (rules C second sentence, D, I1): the abstract names the UK Biobank with case and control counts only; no accession, release, citation or described analysis. A biobank name with only a number of participants is release_not_identified, and the outcome side has UK Biobank GWAS rows, so rule C2 does not make it absent.
